   **Precio y paywall.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 23 ago 2026 - 23 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _HEMA SETH_, 23 ago 2026, 1/5: "I accidentally purchased the annual subscription because I misunderstood the pricing. I believed I was agreeing to a much smaller recurring payment, but approximately ₹7,000 was charged upfront through Google Play. I cancelled the AutoPay mandate immediately and contacted support, requesting a refund for this accidental purchase. I hope the team reviews my case fairly and improves the pricing and purchase flow . And After 4 Days i Also Didn't Receive my Money Back. 😢😢"

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 17 mar 2026 - 8 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Robin med Z_, 17 mar 2026, 2/5: "Overpriced. No way to share with partner without breaking the rules. app crashes. THERES NOT EVEN AN ACTUAL WAY TO INCREASE INTENSITY WITHIN THE PLAN WHEN ITS WAY TOO EASY."
            2. _Barrett_, 8 ago 2026, 4/5: "great app -- used Fitify since 2020! one problem since the ~2024 redesign: it forgets my workout progress and bugs out if i reply to a text/switch apps for a sec. will change review to 5 star when that gets fixed 🙂‍↕️"
<!--/ir-theme-->
